records.statement: SBI's JPY1.1T custody assets and 2.92M accounts are pre-close April 30 combined figures. The Oct 1 Bitbank acquisition is confirmed, but no post-close group-wide XRP custody balance, consolidated reserve address set or customer-liability reconciliation was found.

SBI Visa Crypto Card, Orico points and SBI Shinsei deposit campaigns create documented XRP distribution routes, but reward/points conversion totals, inventory sourcing, hedging and net spot purchases are undisclosed. Do not admit these as measured XRP demand.
SBI VC Trade's RLUSD first-place September custody-balance growth ranking is a relative growth rate, not an absolute balance or net inflow. It does not establish USDC decline or RLUSD market share.

SBI Ripple Asia's tokenized-deposit work is a conceptual proof of concept using XRPL as contemplated infrastructure; no production launch, payment volume, XRP inventory or material XRP fee demand was disclosed.

Japan's 2026 FIEA/PSA amendment is enacted but core crypto provisions and Cabinet Office Ordinance details remain pending. XRP likely falls outside the 'specified cryptoasset' category because no single person can issue new XRP, but this is an inference, not an official classification. Insider-trading rules are likely relevant because XRP is handled by registered exchanges; final scope and commencement require confirmation.
